groupings.title: Forms
groupings.description: Build React form fields that store the right value. Phone, currency, card, duration, cron, colour, file size, IP, percent, mask and mentions — with the canonical-value contract that stops a phone field saving "(415) 555-2671" and a price field saving a float.

groupings.title: Migration
groupings.description: Move an existing form off react-phone-number-input, react-number-format, imask or a hand-rolled input — and fix the value-semantics bug it probably has on the way.
